reviews.text: I went to Dr. Fileccia for a keratosis on my dog's paw. After undergoing surgery once, the problem recurred. The doctor saw no other solution than to operate again. A nasty surprise: after another operation, I discovered another growth on the SAME paw. I wondered, is it possible that under the operating room light, two people failed to notice another growth? Or is it better to ignore it, given that each operation costs at least €500, plus the evaluation and various tests? I was offered to book another appointment to examine the paw. Naturally, we went to another veterinary practice, where they resolved the problem without unnecessary interventions. A big question mark over the competence and honesty of this veterinary "doctor"...
very competent

Studio Associato Veterinaria Preneste is our trusted veterinarian, and we couldn't be more satisfied.

Their expertise, professionalism, and unwavering dedication to animals truly make a difference. You can sense their love for their work and the care they take in each case.

Always available, clear in their explanations, and very reassuring even in the most delicate moments.

An absolute point of reference. Highly recommended! 🐾✨

I was very fortunate to have Dr. Fileccia treat my dog ​​Cesare, who had a serious right ear infection. The doctor, with the help of a fantastic anesthetist, performed an otoscopy, and we finally got to the heart of the problem, which other doctors had not identified until now, also giving me the wrong treatments. Dr. Fileccia is extremely scrupulous and very professional. I am truly satisfied, and above all, I am grateful for how they treated my Cesare, with care and love. Highly recommended.

I thank Dr. Michelle and her anesthesiologist for the excellent extraction of infected teeth for my beloved dog Foxy. The procedure, due to his medical conditions, was not easy. The result was excellent. He was reborn.

Terrible! I had an emergency for my 40-day-old cat. I showed up at 2 PM during the week, and they're supposed to be open. The lights are on everywhere inside, but no one comes to open the door. I called every phone number, and no one answers!!! I waited outside the door for 20 minutes in the cold with a sick puppy!
Professionalism, kindness, helpfulness, and great attention to me and my cat. I felt truly supported, cared for, and supported through the problem my beloved feline companion was having.
